description.value:
The flora, fauna, and elements in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 feet stir, aiding you and your allies and whispering in your ear. This area is known as your waking world. While in your waking world, you and your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics and Acrobatics checks, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge] about creatures and hazards in the area.

The effect lasts for 10 minutes, but you can Dismiss it. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain this ability to increase the burst's size by 10 feet. You can Rouse the World in only one area at a time; if you use this ability again, the first area returns to normal.
